name: file-input
title: File Input
description: Choose, drop or paste files, check them against your rules, and submit them with a form.

files.content:
Class form

Drag and drop files here

Or paste them from your clipboard.

    Data-attribute form

    Drag and drop files here

    Or paste them from your clipboard.

      Accepted types (images and PDFs)

      Drop images or PDFs

      Other file types are left out.

        Limits (3 files, 2 MB each)

        Up to 3 files

        Each file can be up to 2 MB.

          One file (a new file replaces the current one)

          Drop a PDF here

            Folder

            Drop a folder here

            Every file inside it is added.

              Previews (bigger thumbnails)

              Drop images here

              Thumbnails show as soon as they are added.

                Page-wide drop (drag a file over this page)

                Drop files anywhere on this page.

                Drop to attach

                Disabled

                Uploads are turned off

                Ask an administrator to enable them.

                Invalid

                Drop the signed PDF here

                Only PDF files are accepted.

                Add the signed contract to continue.

                Custom variables

                Drop files here

                Square corners, tighter padding.
